I'll start by reading the execution file and understanding the project context.
Implemented CAP-3: the capture route now creates Study Note, Source, and text-only Topic cards.

## What changed

### New capture UI
- `src/features/capture/CapturePage.tsx`
  - `/case/:caseId/capture` step machine: picker → validation → crop → card form / topic form → import → return to case.
  - Separate Take photo and Choose photo inputs accept `image/jpeg`, `image/png`, `image/webp`; only Take photo has `capture="environment"`.
  - Runs `validateImageFile`, shows validation/import progress, opens `CropRotateEditor`, then `NoteSourceForm`.
  - Calls `importImageCard` for photo cards and `repository.createCard` for topics.
  - Handles Retry/Back for decode and write failures; Cancel aborts in-flight work and returns to the case with no card.
  - Revokes preview object URLs on success, crop cancel, failure exit, and unmount.
  - Moves focus to the active step container when the flow changes.
- `src/features/capture/CaptureSourcePicker.tsx`
- `src/features/capture/NoteSourceForm.tsx`
  - Card type, required 1–80 character title, Keep full resolution toggle defaulting off with a storage warning.
- `src/features/capture/TopicForm.tsx`
  - Text-only topic, no file input, required 1–80 character title.
- `src/features/capture/capture.css`
- `src/features/capture/capturePosition.ts`
  - Pure viewport-center placement with a small staggered offset and nonnegative position clamping.

### Route wiring
- `src/app/routes.tsx`
  - Replaced the capture placeholder with the lazy `CapturePage`.
  - Added optional `captureRepository` / `loadCaptureRepository` injection props.

### Tests
- `tests/capture/CaptureFlow.test.tsx`
- `tests/capture/TopicForm.test.tsx`

## Acceptance evidence
- Route is covered through `AppRoutes`; successful saves navigate to `/case/:caseId`.
- Both photo inputs share one validation/crop path; Add topic never mounts a file input and never calls the validator.
- Photo cards commit three attachment kinds (`original`, `display`, `thumbnail`); topics have zero attachments.
- Full-resolution toggle is off by default and is forwarded as `retainFullResolution`.
- Position is computed from the case viewport, visible viewport size, and existing-card count, then persisted with the card.
- Decode and write failures show Retry/Back with no card written; cancel returns to the case with no card.
- Component tests assert step focus, error focus, accessible names, live regions, and 44 px targets.
- CSS and source checks confirm no raw palette literals and no `dangerouslySetInnerHTML`.
- Responsive/announcement behavior uses existing token contrast pairs; reduced-motion overrides are present.

## Validation run
- `npm test -- tests/capture/CaptureFlow.test.tsx tests/capture/TopicForm.test.tsx` — 19 passed
- `npm run typecheck` — passed
- `npm run build` — passed
- Full suite — 398 passed
- `npm run lint` — passed
- `npm run format:check` — passed

Keyboards were exercised through `user-event` tab/Enter/typing flows. The component flow used an injected 1000×800 viewport; no Playwright browser journey was part of this task’s required commands.

## Shared-file handoff
- `src/app/routes.tsx`: preserve the new optional capture repository props and lazy `CapturePage` import.
- `CapturePage` treats persisted `Viewport.x/y` as the visible world top-left corner and derives the center as `x + width / (2 * scale)`. Board-engineer should either adopt that contract or update `capturePosition.ts` when viewport semantics land.

`docs/EXECUTION-AUDIT.jsonl` had a pre-existing engine modification that I did not touch. `docs/artifacts/` was not modified.
